blurb: Guests experience aerial views of Chicago's iconic skyline, Lake Michigan, and the Chicago River from top-of-the-line helicopters piloted by experienced pilots. Tours vary in length and offer unique perspectives of landmarks like Willis Tower and Navy Pier. Safety gear and professional photography are included.
extraNote: Tours may be rescheduled or canceled due to rain, strong winds, or poor visibility · Full refund offered if unable to reschedule due to weather cancellation · Arrive at least 30 minutes before scheduled departure for check-in and safety briefing
